name: seasonalnet-icon-cdn
description: Lucide icon CDN for SeasonalWeather Discord embeds

scripts.check-lucide: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'); const d=p.join(__dirname,'node_modules','lucide-static','icons'); console.log('lucide-static icons:', fs.readdirSync(d).length, 'files');"
scripts.check-config: node -e "const { loadConfig } = require('./lib/config'); const c = loadConfig({ appRoot: __dirname }); console.log('config ok:', c.config_path, c.config_exists ? '(file loaded)' : '(using built-in defaults)');"
